history.recommendation_text: The Board also recommends that the Administration ensure that all United Nations Secretariat entities submit ICT projects with a cost of over $1 million (over a four-year period) to the ICT Steering Committee for approval.
history.administration_response: The Office of Information and Communications Technology requests that this recommendation be closed. To ensure that all Secretariat entities submit to the Information and Communications Technology Steering Committee for approval ICT projects with a cost exceeding $1 million (over a four-year period), the Office has taken the following steps: • On 18 November 2024, the Office issued a memo to Secretariat entities in which reference was made to a previous memo issued in January 2023. Both memos emphasized the requirement for entities to comply with the ICT governance and accountability framework, specifically highlighting the need for entities to submit projects for approval by ICT governance bodies, such as the Information and Communications Technology Steering Committee. • The Office has established an ICT budget review process with Secretariat entities to identify projects that require approval by the Information and Communications Technology Steering Committee. The Office is following up directly with entities to ensure that projects meeting the Information and Communications Technology Steering Committee threshold are submitted for approval. • On 19 February 2025, the Office issued another memo to Secretariat entities regarding the tracking of the implementation of the ICT strategy. This tracker includes a list of projects identified by entity, along with their associated costs and timelines. The Office is working with entities to identify which projects meet the Information and Communications Technology Steering Committee approval threshold to enforce adherence to the ICT governance processes. In line with the evidence provided above and the attached documentation, the Office requests that the recommendation be considered implemented.
history.board_assessment: Given that, although total ICT expenditure amounted to $790 million in 2024, the Information and Communications Technology Steering Committee reviewed only one project, valued at $1.48 million, and that the Project Review Committee held no meetings during 2024, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
